test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

His father asked, "What time do you have class tomorrow, Tom?"

options.text: Tom's father asked what time he has class tomorrow.
Tom's father asked him what time he was having class tomorrow.
Tom's father asked him what time he had class the next day.
Tom's father asked him what tomorrow class timing are.

solution:
The correct option is -** Option 3) Tom's father asked him what time he had class the next day. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in direct speech, and it is a question asked by Tom's father to him. To convert this sentence into indirect speech, **the reporting verb "asked" needs to be changed according to the tense of the sentence, and the question needs to be changed into a statement.**
 
• In indirect speech, the sentence will start with the subject, i.e., Tom's father, followed by the reporting verb "asked" and the conjunction "what" will be changed into "when" to indicate the next day. The pronoun "you" will be changed to "him," and the verb "have" will be changed to "had" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct indirect speech sentence is "**Tom's father asked him what time he had class the next day**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect as it uses the present tense "has" instead of the past tense "had" for the reported speech.
 
• **Option 2** is incorrect as it uses the continuous form "was having" instead of the simple past tense "had" for the reported speech.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect as it does not use correct grammar and word order.
